info.name: Yapily Hosted Pages Hosted Payment Pages API
info.description:
Hosted Payment Pages and Hosted Consent Pages endpoints providing Yapily-managed UI flows for payments and data access without building your own consent UI.

Contact Support:

 Email: support@yapily.com
